release_summary: Referral KPI from ARDTS, updated call metrics, and nursing KPI cleanup
release_details: The dashboard now includes a Referral KPI section with live data from ARDTS — monthly status counts, booking and completion rates, pipeline stages, and trend charts. Call performance KPIs now track total incoming, answered, and missed/abandoned calls. Nursing KPIs no longer include Annuals Supported (Nursing). The reporting month defaults to the last completed month.
change_title: Referral KPI section in the NMAC master KPI navigation
Live ARDTS referral status counts by selected month
Referral trend charts — sent by month, booked vs needs action, status breakdown
Call performance KPIs — Total Incoming, Answered, and Missed/Abandoned Calls
Referral KPI layout — month tabs, balanced status cards, and period summary
Removed Annuals Supported (Nursing) from Nursing KPIs
Default reporting month opens on the last completed month
